item.title: How an Internal Podcast Will Benefit Your Organization
item.description: Companies are discovering how well-suited private podcasts are for many internal communications needs. When combining internal podcasts with other learning tools and resources, organizations really start to see improved results.

item.title: Are shorter podcasts better for business?
item.description: If you don’t need 45 minutes to deliver your message, why waste your customer, vendor, partner, or employees’ time? It’s okay to fit the episode length to the content length.

item.title: 8 Food and Hospitality Founders Share Their Stories In StoriDot Mini-Podcasts
item.description: We were amazed at the variety of origin stories we’ve heard— from a path to sobriety, to a pivot from art school, and a new direction discovered in retirement. But, all of the stories shared one common feature— a personal connection to the food and a passion to create a community around that food.

item.title: Can Podcasts Change Non-Profit Fundraising?
item.description: Podcasts tell compelling stories to engage an audience. Ensuring the fiscal sustainability of a charity is all about telling compelling stories to drive donations and support. The connection is undeniable. So, shouldn't you be using audio to drive your mission?

item.title: Living in a Materiae World Launches!
item.description: The new podcast, "Living in a Materiae World," is hosted by brand builder and beauty industry expert David Pirrotta—an industry veteran who has helped build 76 brands (and counting!)—who helps you navigate the ever-evolving world of makeup, hair, skin, wellness, and more.

item.title: Fashion Business Podcasts For Insiders
item.description: Our philosophy in producing podcasts has always been to tell the most interesting stories. If you’re going to talk about innovation, it should be inspiring. We know that we have a business-to-business audience for all of these shows and executives are busy people, so we try not to waste their time when they're listening to one of our shows.

item.title: StoriDot Is A Powerful New Engagement Tool For Artists, Museums, and Galleries
item.description: StoriDot, a location-based audio solution, is changing how art is experienced in public.

item.title: Turning Up Your Retail Engagement: Audio Stories For The Holidays
item.description: StoriDot Technology Drives An Engagement Boost, Enabling Richer Retail Experiences For Customers

item.title: 7 Great Podcasts with Female Founders Transforming the Beauty Industry
item.description: Female founders are transforming the beauty industry. These founders are using their personal experience as beauty consumers to drive innovation in an industry ripe for disruption.

item.title: Tecovas Recognized For High-Growth D2C In The Lead’s Foremost 50 List
item.description: Tecovas boots are handmade in León, Mexico, where the leatherworking tradition goes back generations. On top of the traditional roots is a tech-forward brand, and that is now being acknowledged for success in D2C in a big way.
